title: Improving Diffraction Quality of Leucyl-tRNA Synthetase 1 with Methylation and Cryoprotectants
author: Kim, Yoon, et al.

steps.title: Prepare cell lysate
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen cells on ice, resuspend each L culture in 50 mL lysis Buffer A, and transfer the suspension to a beaker kept on ice.

steps.title: Sonicate and clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Sonicate the cell suspension for 6 min at amplitude 60 with cycles of 2 s on/6 s off while keeping on ice; centrifuge the lysate at 24 878 × g for 1 h at 4 °C; filter the supernatant through a 0.45 µm Millex‑HV syringe filter.

steps.title: Ni²⁺ affinity chromatography
steps.instruction: Wash a HisTrap HP 5 mL Ni²⁺ column with 50 mL Histrap elution buffer A, equilibrate with 50 mL Histrap binding buffer A, inject the clarified supernatant at 3 mL/min at 4 °C, wash with 50 mL Histrap wash buffer A, elute with a linear 4 %–100 % gradient of Histrap elution buffer A, analyse fractions by 12 % SDS‑PAGE and pool the target fractions.

steps.title: Ion‑exchange chromatography
steps.instruction: Dilute the pooled Ni²⁺ eluate up to 10‑fold with Q binding buffer A, wash a HiTrap Q FF column with 50 mL Q elution buffer A, equilibrate with 50 mL Q binding buffer A, inject the diluted protein at 3 mL/min at 4 °C, wash with 100 mL Q binding buffer A, elute with a linear 0 %–100 % gradient of Q elution buffer A, analyse fractions by 12 % SDS‑PAGE, pool the target fractions and concentrate to 2 mL using an Amicon Ultra‑15 30 kDa centrifugal filter.

steps.title: Gel‑filtration of native protein
steps.instruction: Equilibrate a HiLoad 26/600 Superdex 200 pg column with 120 mL gel‑filtration buffer at 1 mL/min using an AKTA Purifier 100, centrifuge the protein at 24 878 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, inject 2 mL onto the column at 1 mL/min at 4 °C, run buffer at 1 mL/min until the protein elutes, analyse by 12 % SDS‑PAGE, pool the fractions, concentrate to ≈25 mg/mL with an Amicon Ultra‑15 30 kDa filter and store at –80 °C. All steps are performed at 4 °C.

steps.title: Reductive methylation of LARS1
steps.instruction: Using HEPES (or phosphate) buffer without amino groups or alcohols, transfer 1 mL of protein (1 mg/mL) to a micro‑centrifuge tube, wrap in aluminum foil, add 20 µL 1 M dimethyl‑amine‑borane (DMAB) and 40 µL 1 M formaldehyde at 4 °C, shake in the dark on a gel shaker at 100 rpm for 2 h; repeat the addition of 20 µL DMAB + 40 µL formaldehyde and shake 2 h; add 10 µL 1 M DMAB and shake 4 °C for 12–18 h; quench with 125 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, then add DTT to a final concentration of 1–5 mM. Keep all reagents ice‑cold and the tube wrapped between manipulations; buffer pH 6.0–8.0 is recommended.

steps.title: Gel‑filtration of methylated protein
steps.instruction: Equilibrate a Superdex 200 pg column with 120 mL gel‑filtration buffer at 1 mL/min, reduce the methylated protein volume to 2 mL with an Amicon Ultra‑15 30 kDa filter, centrifuge at 24 878 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, inject at 1 mL/min at 4 °C, run buffer at 1 mL/min until elution, analyse by 12 % SDS‑PAGE, pool fractions, concentrate to ≈25 mg/mL and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare protein‑ligand mixtures for crystallization
steps.instruction: Thaw purified and frozen LARS1 and methylated LARS1 on ice; incubate LARS1 with 2 mM leucine (LARS1‑Leusyn), with 2 mM leucine + 1 mM ATP (LARS1‑ATPsyn), with 2 mM leucine + 1 mM Leu‑AMS (LARS1‑Leu‑AMSsyn), and incubate methylated LARS1 with 2 mM leucine + 1 mM Leu‑AMS (LARS1methyl‑Leu‑AMSsyn) for 1 h prior to crystallization.

steps.title: Set up crystallization drops
steps.instruction: Perform initial sitting‑drop vapor diffusion screening at 20 °C using an MRC 2‑well plate and index kit. Then, for hanging‑drop experiments: – LARS1‑Leusyn: mix 1 µL ≈25 mg/mL LARS1 with 1 µL reservoir (0.1 M bis‑tris pH 6.5, 1.6 M ammonium sulfate) at 20 °C; crystals appear in 2–3 days. – LARS1‑ATPsyn, LARS1‑Leu‑AMSsyn, and LARS1methyl‑Leu‑AMSsyn: mix 1 µL ≈17 mg/mL (methylated) LARS1 with 1 µL reservoir (0.1 M HEPES pH 7.1, 0.42 M ammonium sulfate, 24 % PEG 3350) at 20 °C; crystals appear within 5 days.

steps.title: Cryoprotect LARS1‑Leusyn crystals
steps.instruction: Using a cryoloop, transfer LARS1‑Leusyn crystals to a 9‑Well Glass Plate containing 20 µL cryoprotectant (25 % glycerol + 2 mM leucine) in the reservoir, seal with Crystal Clear tape, immediately place the plate in a –20 °C freezer and store for 1 day.

steps.title: Freeze LARS1‑Leusyn crystals in liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the –20 °C freezer, pick the crystals with a cryoloop, transfer them into a Uni‑Puck under liquid nitrogen, then move the puck to a dry shipper filled with liquid nitrogen and flash‑freeze until data collection. Perform rapidly in a 4 °C cold room to avoid damage at 20 °C.

steps.title: Cryoprotect and flash‑freeze other crystals
steps.instruction: Transfer crystals of LARS1‑ATPsyn, LARS1‑Leu‑AMSsyn, and LARS1methyl‑Leu‑AMSsyn to a cryoprotectant solution containing 25 % glycerol in the respective reservoir solution and immediately flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Collect and process diffraction data
steps.instruction: Collect X‑ray diffraction datasets at a synchrotron, index, integrate and scale the images with HKL2000, obtain initial phases by molecular replacement using Phaser with PDB entry 1WKB, perform density modification with Solomon in CCP4i Suite, carry out automated model building with Autobuild in PHENIX, refine the structures with PHENIX, and manually build remaining residues using Coot.
